name: When should I engage a closing coordinator for my luxury condo sale?

mainEntity.name: When should I engage a closing coordinator for my luxury condo sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is best to engage a closing coordinator as soon as your luxury condo is under contract. Early engagement allows for immediate attention to critical timelines, such as inspection periods, and ensures all necessary disclosures and documents are prepared efficiently. This proactive approach helps mitigate potential issues before they become significant problems, ensuring a smoother transaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engage a coordinator as soon as your condo is under contract to manage timelines and documents efficiently.
